finalists.label: Rapidly Involuting Congenital Hemangioma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive evidence, including a small vein within the plaque and an extensive network of small superficial branching vessels.

finalists.label: Vascular malformation
finalists.why: It is supported by the presence of a small vein and an extensive network of small superficial branching vessels, although it is less specific than Rapidly Involuting Congenital Hemangioma.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a small vein within the plaque and an extensive network of small superficial branching vessels, as well as a working diagnosis of probable RICH, decided the final comparison in favor of Rapidly Involuting Congenital Hemangioma.
